name: veloria-pos
description: Veloria PoS — Professional Offline-First Retail POS (Windows Desktop, French, DZD)
author: Veloria

scripts.clean:logs: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');for (const f of fs.readdirSync('.')){if(f.endsWith('.log'))try{fs.rmSync(f)}catch{}};for (const p of ['logs']){try{fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})}catch{}}"
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:electron && npm run typecheck:manager && npm run typecheck:mobile && npm run typecheck:owner
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:coverage:features && npm run verify && npm run build && npm run build:electron && npm run build:manager-client && npm run build:manager && npm run knip
scripts.verify: npm run verify:migrations && npm run verify:domain && npm run verify:fr && npm run verify:encoding && npm run verify:perf && npm run version:check && npm run license:scan
scripts.build:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && esbuild electron/preload/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --external:electron --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/preload/preload.js --log-level=warning && node scripts/release/stamp-electron-pkg.js && node scripts/licensing/sign-integrity.mjs --if-key-present
scripts.package: npm run license:scan && npm run build && npm run build:electron && npm run license:integrity && electron-builder --config config/electron-builder/pos.yml
scripts.package:win: npm run license:scan && npm run build && npm run build:electron && npm run license:integrity && electron-builder --win --config config/electron-builder/pos.yml
scripts.package:portable: npm run license:scan && npm run build && npm run build:electron && npm run license:integrity && electron-builder --win portable --config config/electron-builder/pos.yml
scripts.build:manager: tsc -p tsconfig.manager.json && node --input-type=commonjs -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist-license-manager/license-manager/renderer',{recursive:true,force:true})" && esbuild license-manager/preload/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --external:electron --format=cjs --outfile=dist-license-manager/license-manager/preload/preload.js --log-level=warning && node scripts/release/stamp-electron-pkg.js
scripts.build:pos: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && vite build
scripts.dev:manager: npm run build:manager-client && npm run build:manager && electron ./dist-license-manager/license-manager/main/main.js
scripts.package:manager: npm run license:scan && npm run build:manager-client && npm run build:manager && npm run license:integrity-manager && electron-builder --win -c config/electron-builder/manager.yml
